{{Quote|Mandalore the Hammerborn grew up in the alleys of Kol Atorn, learning accented ''Mando'a'' from the emigrants and exiles who had settled there.|Tor Vizsla|<ref name="TBHC" />}}
'''Mandalore the Hammerborn''' was a [[Mandalorian/Legends|Mandalorian]] who grew up in alleys on the astronomical object [[Kol Atorn]], far from the Mandalorian [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]] of [[Mandalore/Legends|Mandalore]]. During their [[Time/Legends|time]] on Kol Atorn, they learned an accented version of [[Mando'a/Legends|''Mando'a'']]<ref name="TBHC" />&mdash;the Mandalorian [[Language/Legends|language]]<ref name="TMPaC">{{InsiderCite|86|The Mandalorians: People and Culture}}</ref>&mdash;from emigrants and exiles who settled on Kol Atorn.<ref name="TBHC" /> At some point between approximately [[7000 BBY]] and [[60 BBY/Legends|60 BBY]],<ref name="Date">Per ''[[The Bounty Hunter Code: From the Files of Boba Fett]]'', Mandalore the Hammerborn ruled as [[Mandalore (title)/Legends|Mandalore]] after [[Mandalore the First/Legends|Mandalore the First]], whose reign ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'' dates to approximately [[7000 BBY]]. ''The Bounty Hunter Code'' also establishes that ''[[Ba'jurne Kyr'tsad Mando'ad]]'', which mentions Mandalore the Hammerborn's past reign, was supposedly [[Author/Legends|authored]] by [[Tor Vizsla]]&mdash;an authorship the authenticity of which was doubted by [[Jango Fett]]&mdash;at some point after the [[Battle of Galidraan]], which occurred in [[44 BBY/Legends|44 BBY]] per ''[[The Essential Guide to Warfare]]''. Fett [[Showdown on Corellia|killed]] Vizsla during the main flashbacks of [[Jango Fett: Open Seasons 4|''Jango Fett: Open Seasons'' 4]], the events of which ''[[The Cestus Deception]]'' and ''[[The New Essential Chronology]]'' date to approximately three [[Standard year/Legends|years]] after the Battle of Galidraan, or around [[41 BBY/Legends|41 BBY]]. In addition, according to [[Jango Fett: Open Seasons 2|''Jango Fett: Open Seasons'' 2]], Fett also held the title of Mandalore from the time of the [[Battle of Korda Six|death]] of the previous Mandalore, [[Jaster Mereel]], up until&mdash;per ''[[Order 66: A Republic Commando Novel]]''&mdash;his own [[Death/Legends|death]], which took place in [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]] per ''The New Essential Chronology''. Per ''The Essential Guide to Warfare'', Mereel became Mandalore in [[60 BBY/Legends|60 BBY]], and ''Open Seasons'' 2 dates his death to thirty years before the [[First Battle of Geonosis/Legends|Battle of Geonosis]] and thereby around [[52 BBY/Legends|52 BBY]] per ''The New Essential Chronology''. Therefore, Mandalore the Hammerborn must have ruled as Mandalore at some point between approximately 7000 [['ABY-BBY' dating system/Legends|BBY]] and 60 BBY.</ref> they claimed the title of [[Mandalore (title)/Legends|''Mand'alor'']],<ref name="TBHC" /> the traditional ruler of the Mandalorian clans.<ref name="TMPaC" />

Some time after Mandalore the Hammerborn's reign, they were remembered in ''[[Ba'jurne Kyr'tsad Mando'ad]]'', a manifesto of the [[Death Watch/Legends|Death Watch]] splinter group claimed to have been [[Author/Legends|written]] by the group's founder, [[Tor Vizsla]]. However, Death Watch's opponent [[Jango Fett/Legends|Jango Fett]] questioned the authorship. Jango's son, the [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] [[Boba Fett/Legends|Boba Fett]], later included the manifesto in the [[Book/Legends|book]] ''[[The Bounty Hunter Code]]''<ref name="TBHC" /> at some point between [[0 BBY/Legends|0 BBY]] and [[4 ABY/Legends|4 ABY]].<ref name="TBHCCreation">Per ''[[The Bounty Hunter Code: From the Files of Boba Fett]]'', ''[[The Bounty Hunter Code]]'' was created after the [[Death/Legends|death]] of [[Greedo/Legends|Greedo]] but before the [[Great ReSynchronization calendar|date]] 39:3:22, which corresponds to [[4 ABY/Legends|4 ABY]] per the reasoning [[Template:YearMathGRS|here]]. {{Film|IV}} depicts Greedo's death during events ''[[The New Essential Chronology]]'' dates to [[0 BBY/Legends|0 BBY]].</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
Mandalore the Hammerborn was mentioned in the [[2013]] reference book ''[[The Bounty Hunter Code: From the Files of Boba Fett]]''.<ref name="TBHC" />
